speech: none; explanation is given as full-screen text cards between clips
description: A pinned app disappears from the Icons-only Task Manager when its window is moved to another virtual desktop with a keyboard shortcut.
expected_report: With a pinned app in the vertical Icons-only Task Manager and two virtual desktops, the user opens the app from its pinned icon and moves its window to the next desktop with a keyboard shortcut. Expected: the icon stays as a normal pinned launcher. Actual: the icon vanishes from the task manager until the user switches desktops or presses Meta. Text cards also say it sometimes happens with apps minimized to tray.
difficulty: The action is a keyboard shortcut (only its effect is visible), the evidence is a small icon vanishing in a narrow vertical panel, busy fractal wallpaper, dark windows, explanation only as on-screen text.
